saxpy_f32.why_this_kernel_is_in: two flops over twelve bytes, so a large region is bound by memory bandwidth

mixed_u64.why_this_kernel_is_in: a dependent integer mix in registers, so a large region is bound by the cores

sum_u64_wrap.why_this_kernel_is_in: wrapping addition is order independent, so a reassociating baseline is the same function

dot_f64.why_this_kernel_is_in: a strict in-order fold and a reassociating reduction are different functions, not two speeds

compact_even.why_this_kernel_is_in: the certified collector against std::copy_if and a two-pass parallel compaction

histogram_u32.why_this_kernel_is_in: the lane rule forbids the shared-bin parallel shape, so the CAIRN arm is sequential

stencil_1d.why_this_kernel_is_in: the out-of-place shape is accepted and the in-place shape is refused, which no C++ toolchain refuses

preregistered_rejection.message: x is written by lanes, so every lane may touch only x[i], or only its own block x[i * S + j] with j below one constant S.

tasks_split.why_this_kernel_is_in: four visibly disjoint parts under leases, against std::thread, OpenMP sections and parallel_invoke
